timeline.summary: On April 22, 2026, Pace Digitek appointed a cost auditor, designated senior management personnel, and authorized a postal ballot for related party transactions.
On April 23, 2026, Pace Digitek announced an OEM exclusivity agreement with NEC XON Systems for marketing BESS and energy solutions across South Africa, Botswana, Mozambique, Namibia, and Mauritius.
Pace Digitek announced an OEM partnership with NEC XON Systems for exclusive BESS product distribution across 5 African countries.
On May 7, 2026, Pace Digitek announced bagging multiple contracts worth ₹701.95 Cr (including GST) from Damodar Valley Corporation for a 250MW/500MWh BESS project in Jharkhand.
Pace Digitek submitted its Monitoring Agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, reporting ₹215.67 Cr of unutilized IPO proceeds.
On May 16, 2026, Pace Digitek received a ₹709.92 Cr (including GST) turnkey and O&M contract from NLC India Renewables for a 250MW/500MWh BESS project in Tamil Nadu.
On May 18, 2026, Pace Digitek announced a ₹7,099 million BESS EPC and 12-year O&M contract from NLC India Renewables.
On May 20, 2026, Pace Digitek received a ₹264.65 Cr (including GST) contract from BSNL for Bharatnet middle mile network in Sikkim.
Pace Digitek received a ₹264.65 Cr advance work order from BSNL on May 20, 2026, for the BharatNet project in Sikkim.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,096.78 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹99.16 Cr.
Pace Digitek issued an investor presentation for Q4 and FY26 with FY27-FY28 revenue guidance.
Pace Digitek announced postal ballot voting results where two related party transaction resolutions passed and four failed.
Pace Digitek Limited’s Meghana M P announced the audio recording of the investor call on audited Q4 FY2026 results, available on the company website.
Pace Digitek hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, maintaining its FY27 revenue guidance at ₹3,200–3,400 Cr and detailing plans to scale BESS capacity to 10 GWh.
Promoters Venugopalrao Maddisetty, Padma Maddisetty, Rajiv Maddisetty, and Lahari Maddisetty declared no encumbrance on shares held by them or the Promoter Group as of March 31, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹808.17 Cr (+51.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹93.89 Cr (+46.5% YoY).
Pace Digitek filed the Crisil Ratings Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
Pace Digitek reported H1FY27 revenue of ₹1,363.50 Cr, upgraded FY27 revenue guidance, and outlined BESS capacity expansion plans.
